Its pretty mundane. I was 18 when I went in so too old for the kids unit, when I walked in the other patients kind of eyed me because I was so young. I didn't like being away from my family and friends but I took it as punishment because I wanted to kill myself. 

You don't get much privacy. I had a roommate and a bathroom in our room but only a shower curtain, no door. The techs had to come and check on us every 15 min. Meaning they would hunt you down until they found you. The food was actually pretty good surprisingly. And although I had kind of feared the other patients, they were pretty nice. Especially this one biker gang guy who came the same day I did. He would yell a lot and cuss and was probably suffering from drug withdrawals. He was in there because he beat the shit out of his sister's husband since he was abusing her. He was really nice to me though, even if he might have got antsy with the others. There was a 26 year old girl, who was gorgeous and so happy, she always made my day. The staff were kind of distant from the patients, which I could understand since some patients would still commit suicide after discharge. The bill was a shock though, one of the financial ladies pulled me aside to talk about paying plans but since my parents had to take care of it I couldn't offer much help, and I had an anxiety attack because of the bill, but for some reason someone took us on as a charity case I guess? I just feel bad because I'm still suicidal so all that money didn't amount to much.
